title: Go for It, Nakamura-kun!! / Super Exciting Cooking Class!!
overview: Shy high school first-year, Nakamura Okuto, falls in love at first sight with his classmate, Hirose Aiki.

title: Panic! The Secret Bible!!
overview: One morning, the classroom is thrown into chaos when something small and dark scurries across the floor.

title: Wait, Could This Be Love?!
overview: Nakamura is completely unmotivated to sketch in art class until Hirose is chosen as the model.

title: The Miraculous Magical Holy Water!!
overview: While Nakamura is brooding and emitting a negative aura, he’s recruited by Aokiyama Reiko for her club.

title: Vexing! Are They an Item?!
overview: Hirose’s rubbing his muscles, sitting in his lap, and holding hands... with a male friend?!

title: I Want to Be "Friends" with You!!
overview: The class takes a field trip to Yokohama’s Chinatown.

title: Gh-Ghost! School Ghost Stories?!
overview: The Drama/AV Club plans to make a film about the ghost story the whole school is talking about.

title: Crisis! A Rival Appears?!
overview: Nakamura is overjoyed to walk home with Hirose, but a handsome boy is waiting for them at the gate.

title: Pursuit! A Cultural Festival on a Starry Night!!
overview: Nakamura yearns to walk around the school festival with Hirose, but instead, he finds himself alone.

title: A New Discovery! A Study Session After School!! / Super Exciting! Love Bento Autograph Signing!!
overview: Nakamura studies at the library with Hirose and attends the signing event of his favorite author.

title: Grab It! The Presents Scramble! / Makeover? The Hair Cut Challenge!!
overview: Nakamura shops for a Christmas present for Hirose and accidentally cuts his bangs too short.

title: You and I Are "Friends"!!
overview: It’s Valentine’s Day, and Nakamura is secretly nervous about giving “friend chocolate” to Hirose.

title: Even Then, I Love You!!
overview: Nakamura learns Hirose has a girlfriend and decides to secretly support them, but...
